searchText: Supporting v2 would be a (comparatively i guess) big implementation effort, and maintaining 2 streams is kinda nasty code wise given all the definitions etc... optionally could start a v2 and only implement these 2 event types in it? does mean event and event v2 would live a long time potentially If it's going to be too much work for client teams to support 2 streams then we're stuck with modifying v1. In which case, a `versioned_attestation` event sounds like the only viable option. eventstream is just messy, im not sure if its messy in all languages, but theres lists of clients etc etc that would all have to be duplicated, at least in our case... will hopefully get feedback from more teams....
